about_short_description.short_description: ShopMy connects brands and creators for seamless partnership and monetization.

product.name: ShopMy
product.description: A creator-commerce platform that connects brands and creators for affiliate monetization, brand partnerships, product discovery, and performance tracking.

product.name: ShopMy for Creators
product.description: Tools and services that help creators build digital shops, share affiliate links, participate in brand partnerships, and earn revenue from product recommendations.

product.name: ShopMy for Brands
product.description: Brand-facing tools for discovering creators, managing partnerships, tracking campaign results, and expanding affiliate and influencer marketing programs.

product.name: ShopMy for Shoppers
product.description: A shopping discovery experience where consumers browse products and recommendations by curator, circle, brand, category, or personal taste profile.
